name: Boon of the Night Spirit
summary: +1 to any ability (max 30); in Dim Light or Darkness, turn Invisible as a Bonus Action and resist most damage.

benefits.name: Merge with Shadows
benefits.summary: In Dim Light or Darkness, become Invisible as a Bonus Action until you take an action, Bonus Action or Reaction.
benefits.text: While you are within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action or a Reaction.

benefits.name: Shadowy Form
benefits.summary: In Dim Light or Darkness, Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.
benefits.text: While you are within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant damage.
